name: Yamaha TDR250
engine: 249 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke twin from the TZR
intro: A road-biased trail bike with a two-stroke twin.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Yamaha dealer to run the VIN as well.
